    H

    handleDisconnect() - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am56.controller.GameController
    Aborts the current game following an unrecovered disconnection: it notifies the model (so the remaining clients are told the game was aborted), deletes the saved game so it cannot be resumed, and then shuts the server process down shortly afterwards.
    handleDisconnect() - Method in interface it.polimi.ingsw.am56.core.UpdateHandler
    Called when the connection to the server is lost.
    handleDisconnect() - Method in class it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.ConnectionManager
    Handles the loss of the underlying connection by notifying the downstream handler and starting a background loop that retries the connection (over RMI or socket, per useRmi) every RETRY_DELAY_MS until it succeeds; on success the new adapter is installed and the downstream handler is told it has reconnected.
